versions.changelog:
- Initial release of multimodal-gen: a multimodal content generation skill.
- Supports text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video, and speech-to-text tasks.
- Provides unified prompt structure and invocation standards, connecting with built-in ImageGen and VideoGen tools.
- Includes built-in prompt construction helper scripts.
- Designed for use cases such as illustration, poster, video asset generation, and audio transcription.
- Implements guidance for cost control, learning system scripts, and content safety boundaries.
